TABLE.NAME: qtype_ddto_chill_options
TABLE.COMMENT: Options for Drag-drop into text Chill questions: negative marking, all-or-nothing mode and shuffling.

FIELD.NAME: negativemarking
FIELD.COMMENT: Penalty for each incorrectly filled gap, as a fraction of the question mark, between -1 and 0.

FIELD.NAME: allornothing
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if the mark is only awarded when every gap is filled correctly.

FIELD.NAME: shuffleanswers
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if the choice bank is shuffled for each attempt.

TABLE.NAME: qtype_ddto_chill_choices
TABLE.COMMENT: Choices (gap answers and distractors) for Drag-drop into text Chill questions.

FIELD.NAME: text
FIELD.COMMENT: Plain-text choice shown in the bank and in the drop-down fallback.

FIELD.NAME: choicegroup
FIELD.COMMENT: Choice group. v1 uses a single pool (group 1) for every gap.

FIELD.NAME: fraction
FIELD.COMMENT: 1.0 if this choice is the correct answer of at least one gap, 0.0 for a distractor.
